newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australia's North West Shelf sold on NWS basis.
newsitem.headline: Australia's North West Shelf sold on NWS basis.

text.p: An Australian producer has sold a cargo of North West Shelf (NWS) condensate on the basis of NWS quotes rather than the traditional Arun-based quotes, industry sources said on Friday.

The 630,000-barrel February 5-10 cargo was sold to a North Asia buyer at APPI NWS quotes plus 25/30 cents per barrel. It is the third deal on the basis of APPI quotes carried out by the producer, the sources said.
Traditionally, Indonesia's 70,000 barrels-per-day Arun condensate has been used by the industry as the marker for selling other condensates.
But critics have argued for some years that Arun production is declining and more importantly that few Arun barrels are available on the spot market.
This has prompted sellers of North West Shelf to move away from using Arun as the basis for their sales.
APPI's weekly assessment this week for Arun was $23.28 per barrel (mid-point) and $23.81 for North West Shelf, a difference of 58 cents.
Recent deals for January and February NWS, on the basis of Arun, have been at Arun plus 68 cents and Arun plus 80 cents.
